@startuml

class FamilyInsured {
  + NameOfFamilyHead
  + Address
  + Telephone
  + InsuranceCarrier
  + PolicyNumber
}

class Patient {
  + Name
  + Gender
  + Birthdate
  + Allergies
  + Notes
}

class Appointment {
  + Date
  + Time
  + Reason
}

class Doctor {
  + Name
  + Specialty
  + Address
  + Telephone
  + PagerNumber
  + SSN
}

class Visit {
  + Date
  + Weight
  + BloodPressure
  + Temperature
  + Reason
  + DiagnosisNotes
  + TreatmentNotes
}

class Prescription {
  + Date
  + Medication
  + Dosage
  + Number
}

FamilyInsured "1" -- "1..*" Patient
FamilyInsured "1" -- "1" Doctor : hasPrimaryCare
Patient "1" -- "0..*" Appointment
Patient "1" -- "0..*" Visit
Visit "0..1" -- "0..1" Appointment
Doctor "1" -- "1..*" Visit
Visit "1" -- "0..*" Prescription

@enduml
